entries.claim: Hypercore is loan-management software for private credit / direct lending that manages origination, underwriting, servicing, amendments, restructurings, and repayment.
entries.notes: Vendor/public-site claim. UNVERIFIED until partner-gated access. Used only for domain framing, not for any delivered value.

entries.claim: Hypercore exposes a REST read/write API plus real-time webhook events and integrates with Salesforce, NetSuite, and document repositories; exact endpoints/schemas/auth/pagination are partner-gated.
entries.notes: API specifics UNVERIFIED until access. Treated as TBD/Assumption; the skill writes ONLY against read endpoints (read-only constraint) and stubs all live calls behind the adapter.

entries.claim: Likely Hypercore read entities to model: loans/facilities, borrowers/entities, drawdowns/fundings, payments/repayments, fees, interest accruals, amortization schedules, covenants/compliance, collateral, investor allocations, documents.
entries.notes: Entity list is a likely-set Assumption; field-level schemas TBD pending API docs. Drives data-model.md subject entities and the normalized layer.

entries.claim: Pre-generation-verification-gate (ACOS LEARN): a mandatory non-bypassable gate between extraction and delivery shows every data point with source + provenance + confidence and caps single-source figures at confidence <= 0.7.
entries.notes: Validated internal prior. Directly grounds provenance-binding, refuse-on-missing, confidence cap, and the gate suite.

entries.claim: Adversarial-consensus pattern (acos-dataroom-v2 / acos-financial-statement / acos-grader): N blind independent agents with asymmetric/quorum consensus gating must agree before a result is accepted.
entries.notes: Validated internal prior. Grounds the consensus orchestrator, substance-consensus definition, blind re-dispatch, and tiered routing. Default quorum 2-of-3 asymmetric (Assumption; finalize per tier at plan time).

entries.claim: A freshness policy is required: define live-fetch vs cached vs webhook-invalidated, and never serve stale data silently.
entries.notes: Risk-driven requirement; webhook contract UNVERIFIED until access, so polling fallback is the Assumption. Concrete window length TBD at plan time.

entries.claim: A pagination-completeness gate is required to prevent silent record truncation by rate limits or cutoffs (reconcile expected vs fetched counts / cursor exhaustion).
entries.notes: Risk-driven deterministic gate. Exact reconciliation mechanism depends on Hypercore pagination scheme (TBD); designed against fixture cursors now.

entries.claim: Schema validation plus drift detection against expected entity schemas is required to handle Hypercore-side schema changes.
entries.notes: Risk-driven deterministic gate. Expected schemas are Assumptions (fixtures) until real schemas land; drift surfaced, not absorbed.

entries.claim: Aggregation/unit/currency errors are the real hallucination-adjacent failure mode and require cross-field reconciliation + unit/currency normalization + adversarial recomputation.
entries.notes: Combines a deterministic gate (normalization/reconciliation) with adversarial recompute (consensus). Highest-leverage correctness control per hypothesis H1.

entries.claim: Two-tier-data-model (LEARN-ARCH-002): a full canonical record with full provenance (source of truth) plus a brief token-efficient derived view; give each agent only the tier it needs.
entries.notes: Validated internal prior. Maps raw cached API responses -> truth; normalized answer layer -> derived. Foundational to provenance + token efficiency.

entries.claim: Client/adapter isolation for an unprovisioned external API (contract-first, fixtures/mocks, graceful degradation) lets the whole skill be built/tested before access; absent credentials it says 'no live data' rather than fabricate.
entries.notes: Architecture constraint mandated by the config. Contract is stable; fixture backend now, live backend later behind the same contract.

entries.claim: Hypercore security posture and OKOA discipline: TLS 1.2+, AES-256 at rest, RBAC, SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, MFA + SSO; borrower PII/financials must not leak into logs/evidence beyond need; secrets via env/secret store.
entries.notes: Vendor posture is T3/UNVERIFIED for specifics but the OKOA-side discipline (PII scrub, env secrets, no creds in repo) is a hard internal rule.

entries.claim: Verified extracts must be shaped as trusted inputs for downstream skills (acos-dataroom-v2, acos-financial-statement, prospectus, legal-analyst) via report/table/dataset (JSON/CSV) formats with embedded provenance/confidence + a manifest.
entries.notes: Feed format set is an Assumption (report + table + dataset + manifest); refine per consumer at plan/tasks time.

entries.claim: Deliverables must be IC-grade / boss-criticism-proof on first cold look; ACOS logs agent identity to .acos/metrics/agent-completions.log and packages per-slice evidence bundles.
entries.notes: Grounds the metrics/instrumentation plan and the IC-grade output standard.

entries.claim: The skill MUST be read-only against Hypercore: no write/mutate code path against the API under any circumstance.
entries.notes: Hard, permanent constraint. Adapter exposes read methods only; structurally enforced.

entries.claim: Subscription-only Claude: never use ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; all model work via main-thread Read or Task() sub-agents.
entries.notes: Hard, permanent OKOA rule (separate API billing forbidden). Consensus agents dispatched via Task() only.
